'''Little Capella''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Little Capella system/Legends|Little Capella system]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], a region in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the company [[Rapora Mining]] operated the [[Rapora Mining Center]] on Little Capella as one of many new facilities throughout the Outer Rim.<ref name="NewsNet" />
